node.label: Nancy F. Cott
node.date_label: The Bonds of Womanhood (1977) · The Grounding of Modern Feminism (1987) · Public Vows (2000)
node.description: A historian of women, gender and American public life whose marriage history treats a seemingly private bond as an institution shaped by state authority. Her interview stresses the historical variability of spouses’ roles and the interaction of legal status and consent.
